name: requestId
label: Request ID
description: An ID to identify the request sent for fetching the list data.

name: timestamp
label: Timestamp
description: The timestamp corresponding to when this event occurred

name: table
label: Table
description: Table Name for current displayed list

name: view
label: View
description: The configured view for the list's table

name: columns
label: Columns
description: Columns that are shown on the list

name: query
label: Query
description: Current query conditions applied to the list

name: rowLimit
label: Row Limit
description: The max number of rows to show per page

name: page
label: Current Page
description: The index of the current page

name: maxColumns
label: Max Columns
description: Choose how many columns to display from the view or from the columns you selected. For example, if a view has 15 columns, you can choose to show only the first 5.
